tunnel_list_empty_description: Import a config to get started.
uninstall_confirm_message: All system extensions used by Phantom-WG will be deactivated, and this user's VPN entries will be removed from System Settings. Your tunnel configurations and keys remain stored and come back on reinstall — to erase them, delete the tunnels in the app before uninstalling. You can then drag Phantom-WG to the Trash.
gate_description: Phantom-WG relies on three system extensions. Activate each one and approve it in System Settings to continue.
detail_stopping_disarm: Stopping. Waiting for the automatic reconnect rule to come down.
detail_delete_confirm_message: This will permanently remove the tunnel configuration.
log_empty_description: Logs will appear here when the tunnel is active.
mdns_toggle_description: Pin mDNSResponder DNS queries to the physical interface so listed apps' indirect DNS (Network.framework / libresolv) stays off the tunnel. Disabling lets indirect DNS fall back to the tunnel resolver. Most users should keep this on.
edit_footer: Edit the configuration freely; saving runs it through the same validation steps as import.
parse_err_duplicate_section: Duplicate [%@] section — only one is supported.
field_err_ip_invalid: '%@' is not a valid IP address.
field_err_address_invalid_prefix: '%@' is not a valid prefix length.
field_err_address_invalid_addr: '%@' is not a valid IP address.
field_err_endpoint_invalid_port: '%@' is not a valid port number.
field_err_endpoint_invalid_host: '%@' is not a valid host (IP or hostname).
field_err_url_invalid_scheme: Scheme '%@' not supported — expected ws:// or wss://.
field_err_url_missing_host: URL is missing the host component.
error_stop_disarm_refused: The tunnel was stopped, but the reconnect rule could not be stood down, so the system may bring it back on its own. %@
error_activation_unresolved: Activation did not finish and the system never reported why. Try again once the tunnel has fully stopped.
error_connected_despite_stop: Connected again after the stop request. The automatic reconnect rule may still be registered; try turning it off again.
error_stop_rule_unconfirmed: Stopped. The system did not confirm that the automatic reconnect rule was taken down.
error_detail_session_ended: The session was ended by the system.
error_duplicate_name: A tunnel with that name already exists.
error_vault_unavailable: Could not write the tunnel secrets to TunnelVault. Make sure the system extension is active.
error_vault_refused: TunnelVault refused the change, so the tunnel secrets were left exactly as they were.
error_uninstall_not_approved: The system's approval for removing the extension was not answered, so the uninstall stopped.
vault_gate_silent_message: Could not reach TunnelVault. Make sure the system extension is active.
vault_gate_door_message: PhantomTunnel is awake, but Keychain is not answering.
connection_gate_title: VPN Connection In Use by Another User
connection_gate_message_named: A VPN connection belonging to another local user ("%@") is currently active on this Mac. Once you end that tunnel connection in System Settings > VPN, your tunnels will appear here.
connection_gate_message: A VPN connection belonging to another local user is currently active on this Mac. Once you end that tunnel connection in System Settings > VPN, your tunnels will appear here.
error_foreign_slot: Another user's VPN is active on this Mac. Turn it off in System Settings > VPN, then try again.
detail_config_unavailable: The configuration could not be read from TunnelVault. It may be corrupted and may need to be imported again.
detail_settings_toggle_note: Starting or stopping this tunnel from System Settings does not change its automatic reconnect: the rule stays exactly as this app last left it. Use the toggle here to change it.
detail_config_unreachable: TunnelVault cannot be reached right now. This is usually temporary — try again once the tunnel extension is awake.
error_reset_nothing_to_rebuild: The extension is not running a tunnel layer, so there was nothing to reset.
error_reset_layer_down: The tunnel layer did not come back up after the reset. The tunnel is not passing traffic; try again or stop it.
error_reset_send_failed: The reset could not be sent to the tunnel extension: %@
error_reset_unanswered: The tunnel extension did not answer the reset. Make sure the extension is active, then try again.
error_reset_outcome_unrecognised: The tunnel extension answered the reset with an outcome this version does not recognise (%d). Check the tunnel before relying on it.
sysext_err_unsupported_location: The app must be in /Applications to install the system extension.
sysext_err_code_signature: Code signature is invalid. The app may need to be re-signed.
sysext_err_validation: System extension validation failed. Check entitlements and provisioning profile.
sysext_err_system_policy: Blocked by system policy. Check System Settings → Privacy & Security.
sysext_err_entitlement: Missing entitlement. The app may need to be re-signed.
split_tunneling_log_empty: Logs will appear here while Split-Tunneling is active.
split_tunneling_enable_description: When disabled the feature is paused; your app list is preserved.
split_tunneling_interface_footer: Traffic from listed apps exits through this interface, regardless of whether a tunnel is active.
split_tunneling_exclude_applications_foo: Listed applications exit through the selected physical interface instead of the active tunnel.
split_tunneling_empty_state_description: Add applications to route their traffic through the selected interface instead of the active tunnel.
split_tunneling_interface_unavailable_me: The physical interface "%@" is not present. Routed apps will fail to connect until it returns or you pick another.
split_tunneling_push_failed: The change could not be delivered to the extensions. It is saved here, but the running session may still be using the previous list.
split_tunneling_stop_residue: Split-tunneling was turned off, but %@ could not be unregistered. Until it is, that extension is still handling traffic even though this screen shows the feature as off.
split_tunneling_reset_confirm_message: This will clear all selected applications and disable the feature. Your configuration cannot be recovered.
split_tunneling_err_not_a_bundle: The selected file is not a valid application bundle.
split_tunneling_err_no_bundle_id: The application has no bundle identifier and cannot be added.
split_tunneling_err_not_signed: The application is not properly signed and cannot be verified.
split_tunneling_err_duplicate: This application is already in the list.
